about_the_game:
KEY GAME FEATURES

Summoners War: Rush is an idle tower defense RPG where you build a team of Monsters to battle. Feast your eyes on fascinating Monster artwork and stunning skill effects, and take on stages and Defense mode bosses with your ever-evolving Monster lineup! Log in now and claim 14 essential top-tier Monsters and all the materials you need to start growing them—for free!

Stages

Climb through stages and face off against increasingly strong bosses. The higher the difficulty, the better the rewards. Exploit each boss's weakness to clear stages faster and reach new heights!

Sky Island Defense (Tower Defense Mode)

Enter Sky Island Defense, a unique tower defense mode. Strategically place your Monsters and unleash skill cards to wipe out waves of incoming enemies. Coordinate support skills to take down powerful bosses.

Don't miss limited-time campaign events tied to new Monster releases—packed with valuable rewards.

Magic Orb

Use Magic Orbs to instantly acquire equipment. If a newly obtained piece is stronger than what's equipped, it will auto-replace to boost your power. Equipment is collected even during battle, making your progression both dynamic and satisfying.

Challenge

Put your skill card usage and Monster placement to the test in Challenge Mode! Face 25 intense waves on massive tower defense maps—twice the size of Sky Island Defense. Make real-time card choices, compete on the leaderboard, and aim for top ranks in new weekly seasons!

Land of Conquest

Hop aboard your airship and conquer zones across the Land of Conquest. Defeat bosses and capture regions to earn loot—including powerful boss Critters.

Guild Dungeon

Join forces with your Guild to defeat powerful dungeon bosses. Form a 50-Monster army—25 from your team and 25 from your Guildmates. Work together, rack up points, and fight for the #1 spot in the Guild rankings!

Critters

Collect Critters that boost your team’s overall stats just by owning them. Each Critter enhances a specific attribute, and their power increases with upgrades and level-ups.

Summon

Strengthen your Monsters to unlock their full potential. Awaken them to gain unique, powerful skills. Use your upgraded team to push back waves of enemies!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3225, AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Audio or higher
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K , AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 / Intel ARC A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Audio or higher
